policy: Reviewed illustrations closely associated with project documents belong in Git. Only exact Docs/Images paths are eligible; each image is limited to 5 MiB and approved byte versions. Production asset images, private correspondence, credentials and unlicensed source images remain excluded. Retain earlier approved hashes when revising a figure so publication history remains verifiable.
